title: Insights into critical metal element migration and enrichment in coal gasification
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8169-8179
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00809C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Juan Cai, Boyan Zhang, Jiatao Dang, Yunpeng Zhao, Dingcheng Liang, Qiang Xie, Maohong Fan, Jinchang Liu
The migration and enrichment of critical metals in coal gasification as the temperature increases from 1000 °C to 1500 °C are revealed in this work, which are beneficial to the development of metal extraction strategies from gasification slag.
